_doc: Module -> release_gate.ps1 steps (arch024 PLAN (c) c-1). Read by `release_gate.ps1 -Module <name>` (step selection),
tools/gates/modules_check.py (validation against a tree and the gate's step list) and tools/impact/impact.py
STATUS: DEV-TIME FAST FEEDBACK ONLY. Not for releases, rc merges or bug-fix releases until the owner signs
off O1 and O2 (arch024 PLAN, sign-off list). Until then a release / rc / bug-fix release runs the full
release_gate.ps1 on both GPUs under the current bug-fix rules (docs/dev/testing.md).
Fields: id (PLAN module id); paths (globs, repo-relative, '/' separators; a diff file matching one belongs to
the module); lands_on (the branch / step that adds the module's files: when no path matches a file in the
tree, the module is 'declared, not on this branch' instead of an error); steps (release_gate step names; one
GPU = run the gate on one card, two = both cards one after the other); pending (steps a later arch024 step
adds to release_gate: printed, not run, never silently dropped; an entry here whose step already exists in
the gate is an error, so the list is cleaned when the step lands); manual (checks outside release_gate,
printed for the runner); when (extra steps when a named file changes); full (the full gate on both GPUs);
callers: "rdeps" = also run the modules of every src/include file that includes the module's files (transitive;
an includer in no module = the full gate), or a list of module names (review A4). release_gate prints, and
impact.py adds as -Steps, the steps the impact map selects beyond this table (PLAN c-2).
Every step name must exist in release_gate.ps1 -List or be in pending, else release_gate exits 2.
status: dev-only: not for releases until owner sign-off O1/O2 (arch024 PLAN)
